## How it works

Connect a provider to your Zenith account and create an app token scoped to that connection. Call the category API with that token. Your app reads the capabilities endpoint to discover support.

Best-effort mode is the default. Native operations call the provider directly. Emulated operations use other supported operations. Unsupported operations return an error. Unsupported input fields are dropped with warnings; strict mode rejects them.

<Visibility for="humans">

Connect providers and create app tokens in [Settings > Integrations](https://app.zenith.hosting/settings/integrations).

</Visibility>
